name: Blog
description: A multi-author blog where signed-in users publish tagged posts that everyone can read
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read posts; require auth for writing posts; restrict updating and deleting a post to its author; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Posts are published as soon as they are created; the author is the signed-in user who created the post, updating or deleting another user's post answers 403, and DELETE /api/posts/:id removes the post permanently

Post validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; content is a required non-empty string of at most 50000 characters; a post has at most 10 tags, each trimmed and lower-cased, 1 to 30 characters, with duplicates dropped

Every post in a response carries author (the author's username), excerpt (the content's first 200 characters with line breaks collapsed to spaces), created_at and updated_at; updated_at changes on every update

GET /api/posts returns active posts newest first; ?query= matches title or content case-insensitively, ?tag= keeps posts carrying that tag, ?author= keeps posts by that username, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 10, at most 50), and total counts every matching post
Deactivated posts (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/posts and answer 404 on the public post endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for another user's post or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the post list and full posts read-only; signed-in users also get a 'Write a post' button and, on their own posts, edit and delete controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to write posts' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Post list: title, excerpt, author, date and tags for each post, a search box, previous/next paging, and clicking a tag or author name filters the list by it
Post page: title, author, created and updated dates, tags and the content with its paragraphs and line breaks preserved
Write and edit form for title, content and tags that shows the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every post, active or not, with its author and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a post's active status from the overview

data_models.name: Post
data_models.description: A published blog post; excerpt is computed from content

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who wrote it)
fields.title: string (required, max 200 chars)
fields.tags: list of strings (at most 10; each trimmed, lower-cased, 1-30 chars, no duplicates)
fields.updated_at: datetime (auto, changes on every update, ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the post from public endpoints)
